{{Quote|Abeloth&hellip;''"<br />"''She was here?''"<br />"''No. In&hellip;dream&hellip; My ship&mdash;take me to my ship. And awaken the Lords. And the defenses&mdash;the city&hellip;she is going to&hellip;to make the city pay&hellip;|Darish Vol and Revar, following the former's mental duel with Abeloth|<ref name="Ascension" />}}
The [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] was '''destroyed''' in [[44 ABY]]. The [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]] was brought to the city to ally with the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] that lived there after she made a pact to help them destroy the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. However, Abeloth had her own plans for [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] domination; she betrayed the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and staged a mental attack on the Sith [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] that left both of them weakened. Vol tried to warn the city of Abeloth's treachery, but he was too late. In her frustration at her failure to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Vol, Abeloth released waves of destructive [[The Force/Legends|Force]] energy upon the city, leaving it in ruins and killing many of its residents. She proceeded to flee in the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] while the remnants of the Tribe's [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]] launched from Tahv's [[Tahv spaceport|spaceport]]. [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]] ordered the Sith to defect to [[Abeloth's fleet]], but several remained loyal to the Tribe and opened [[Laser/Legends|fire]] on the deserters. Khai's [[Black Wave|frigate]] fought off the Sith attack long enough to escape the world, and Abeloth then sent her new forces to distract the Jedi. Their efforts succeeded, as she was able to [[Rokari Kem|rise]] to [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|power]] on the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] capital planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Gavar Khai. Our mutual enemy is proving to be too much for us to deal with individually.|Abeloth, to Gavar Khai|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] discovered the existence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]] and fought in a series of [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|encounters]] against the [[New Jedi Order]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] wanted to capture Abeloth for their own use and destroy the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order, but their [[Mission to the Maw|first mission]] failed. After a [[Operation Shieldfall|second attempt]] left the Tribe empty-handed, [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]], the leader of the [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]] during the operation, was approached by Abeloth with the proposition of an alliance to eliminate their mutual enemy, the Jedi.<ref name="Conviction" /> Khai thus brought Abeloth to the Sith [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], where the Sith [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] convened with the Tribe's [[Circle of Lords]] and eventually decided to accept Abeloth's offer. Abeloth was brought [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-side, and a celebration was held for her in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]].<ref name="Ascension" />

==The destruction==
===Instigation===
{{Quote|Nothing can hold her&hellip; Fool to think I could use her&hellip; What ''is'' she?&hellip; By the dark, the greatest mistake I have ever made&hellip;|Darish Vol, on Abeloth|<ref name="Ascension" />}}
[[File:Tahv.jpg|thumb|left|175px|The city of Tahv]]
Vol still did not trust Abeloth, however, and he secretly convened with several members of the Circle of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]] after the celebrations. Later that night, while Abeloth walked the streets of Tahv, she appeared to Vol in his [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]]&mdash;not in her [[Human/Legends|Human]] guise, but in her true [[Alien/Legends|alien]] form&mdash;and attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him, wrapping her tendrils around him and jamming them into his [[Ear/Legends|ears]], [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]], and [[Nose/Legends|nose]]. She quickly began to consume him, but she was too reckless, and in his desperation Vol used a [[Mnemotherapy|Force technique]] to delve into her mind. His probing showed him that her greatest need was to feel loved. Abeloth was furious at his violation of her mind, and her attack increased in violence.<ref name="Ascension" />

The Grand [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] in turn tried to cause Abeloth as much pain as possible, telling her over and over again that she would never be loved. Stricken, Abeloth's assault morphed into an attempt to flee from the Grand Lord's torment. Vol tried to kill her as she fought to break free from his grasp, but she managed to repulse him, waking him up and leaving him extremely weak and in great pain. He was quickly attended to by the Sith Saber [[Revar]], and the Grand Lord ordered Revar to take him to his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], awaken the Sith Lords, and warn the Tribe's defenses of Abeloth's inevitable impending attack on Tahv.<ref name="Ascension" />

In her agony and frustration at failing to kill Vol, Abeloth lashed out against the city&mdash;unable to hold on to the illusion of her appearance, she reverted back to her true form as she attacked Tahv with surges of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] energy. Despite Vol's attempt to warn the city, the Sith were unprepared for her attack. Beings in her immediate vicinity were imploded by the onslaught, and those a little farther away were completely torn apart by the energy. The city itself also suffered under the assault; [[Glass/Legends|glass]] and weapons were taken up and flung throughout Tahv, serving Abeloth's will to hurt and kill everyone in the city. Buildings melted to the ground, and the city was left rife with flames, with thousands dead.<ref name="Ascension" />

===Escape===
{{Quote|Shields up. We stand with Abeloth. Ship&mdash;''"<br />"''&mdash;is sending coordinates.''"<br />"''Follow them! Tell all vessels to retreat.|Gavar Khai and Tola Annax, ordering the Sith to cover Abeloth's escape|<ref name="Ascension" />}}
Meanwhile, Gavar Khai and several other Sith aboard his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Black Wave]]'', were awakened by Abeloth's radiating agony. Abeloth met the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] while several frigates launched from the city's relatively undamaged [[Tahv spaceport|spaceport]]. Ship contacted Khai through the Force and reported that Abeloth was safe, but that they needed to leave immediately. Meanwhile, Khai's second-in-command, Sith Saber [[Tola Annax]], relayed a request from other frigates in the Sith [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] for orders, reporting that the vessels that had launched from the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] were almost within firing range&mdash;they suspected that the ''Black Wave'' stood with Abeloth, and were preparing to attack. Despite [[Death convulsion|sensing]] the death of his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Lahka Khai|Lahka]], in Abeloth's attack, Khai finally decided to ally fully with Abeloth and desert the Tribe. He commanded his crew to assist Abeloth and ordered all frigates to retreat from the planet with Ship, who relayed coordinates to them for a rendezvous. Not all of the vessels followed Khai's orders, however, and those who remained loyal to the Tribe opened [[Laser/Legends|fire]] on them.<ref name="Ascension" />

[[File:GavarKhai-Allies.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Gavar Khai led the Sith in covering Abeloth's retreat.]]
Two ChaseMaster frigates that had followed the ''Black Wave'' were shot down by the Tribe's forces. Khai ordered his crew to return fire, and one of the attacking frigates was destroyed in the exchange. Now considering himself a member of [[Abeloth's fleet]], Khai ordered that all vessels alter course to the rendezvous point, and stated that all who did not would be considered traitors and attacked. One vessel, the ''[[Dark Dancer]]'', failed to respond, and Annax reported that the ship had been hit. She informed Khai that it might still be on their side but was just too damaged to move or reply. However, Khai refused to accept the risk of allowing the ''Dark Dancer'' to live in case it was still loyal to the Tribe, and he ordered Annax to shoot the vessel down. Khai's frigate opened fire, destroying the ''Dark Dancer'', and Annax successfully completed the ''Black Wave''{{'s}} [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump out of the [[Kesh system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Ascension" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We must not allow ourselves to be traced. I&hellip;need time to recover, and to decide the next course of action. Lead them on a merry chase, Gavar Khai.|Abeloth|<ref name="Ascension" />}}
Following Tahv's destruction, the Sith on Kesh deserted the city, and Abeloth suspected that Grand Lord Vol might decide to ally with the Jedi again in another attempt to bring her down. Upon meeting at the rendezvous spot, Abeloth spoke with Khai regarding his loyalties and his daughter, [[Vestara Khai|Vestara's]], actions&mdash;she had been sent on a mission to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on the Jedi by becoming close to young [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], but the Tribe had come to suspect that she might have turned traitor to the Sith. Abeloth forced Khai to accept the possibility of his daughter's betrayal and went on to denounce the idea of paying any attention to a [[Throne of Balance|prophecy]] of a supposed [[Allana Djo Solo|Jedi queen]] who might prevent the Sith from rising to power in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Finally, she ordered Khai to lead any Jedi or Sith who attempted to pursue her down the wrong path.<ref name="Ascension" />

In that vein, Khai and nine other Sith Sabers confronted the Jedi [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Ben Skywalker, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and Vestara Khai herself on the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. However, in the [[Duel on Dromund Kaas|ensuing duel]], all of the Sabers&mdash;including Khai&mdash;were killed. Khai's daughter was able to discern from her [[Parent/Legends|father's]] actions that he was no longer serving the Tribe, and she soon afterward decided to join the Jedi Order as an [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]]. Later, when the Jedi launched a [[Mission to Upekzar|mission]] to the planet [[Upekzar]] to eliminate Abeloth and Ship, they found only Tola Annax, who had been stripped of her [[Force power/Legends|powers]] by Abeloth and infused with a massive amount of dark side energy that would explode if she was killed. While the Jedi recognized the trap and immediately retreated, Annax was overwhelmed and killed by the energy, though the majority of the Jedi forces managed to escape from the resulting explosion. Still, the distractions gave Abeloth [[Time/Legends|time]] to [[Rokari Kem|infiltrate]] the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|government]] on the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] capital planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where she rose to the position of [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]].<ref name="Ascension" />

==Behind the scenes==
The destruction of Tahv first appeared in [[Christie Golden]]'s ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'' ([[2011]]), the eighth book in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. The event saw the decimation and abandonment of Tahv, a city that was initially introduced in the second ''Fate of the Jedi'' entry, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'' ([[2010]]), also by Golden.
